info.title: Project Nexus Backend API
info.description: RESTful API specifications for Project Nexus: Authentication, RBAC, Profiles, Catalog, Commerce, Fulfillment, and Real-Time Auctions

tags.name: 1. AUTH
tags.description: Authentication & Authorization: Registration, login, OTP, password recovery, and Google OAuth

tags.name: 2. BUYER
tags.description: Buyer Portal: Personal profile, wallet balance, seller upgrade application, and mode switching

tags.name: 3. SELLER
tags.description: Seller Portal: Merchant profile management and seller operational mode switching

tags.name: 4. STAFF
tags.description: Staff Portal: Account activation, credential lifecycle, and staff profiles

tags.name: 5. ADMIN
tags.description: Admin Backoffice: Staff provisioning, seller KYC reviews, user moderation, product curation, shop audits, platform settings, and administrative wallet

tags.name: 6. MEDIA
tags.description: Media Assets: Image and document uploads stored via local server or Cloudinary

tags.name: 7. CATALOG
tags.description: Product Catalog: Categories, product listings, inventory management, and search

tags.name: 8. COMMERCE - CART
tags.description: Shopping Cart: Buyer cart lifecycle, price revalidation, and guest cart merging

tags.name: 8. COMMERCE - ORDERS & PAYMENTS
tags.description: Orders & Payments: Checkout with PayOS VietQR or NEXUS Pay wallet, order lifecycle tracking, and escrow holding

tags.name: 8. COMMERCE - SELLER FINANCE
tags.description: Seller Finance: Balance tracking, net revenue, payout withdrawal requests, and financial ledger

tags.name: 8. COMMERCE - SELLER ORDERS
tags.description: Seller Fulfillment: Order queue management, details, fulfillment status, and GHN logistics handover

tags.name: 9. NOTIFICATIONS
tags.description: Notifications: Real-time WebSocket delivery, REST listing, preferences, and read tracking

tags.name: 10. FULFILLMENT & SHIPPING
tags.description: Logistics & Shipping: GHN carrier integration, parcel shipping quote calculation, and route distance tracking

tags.name: 11. AUCTIONS
tags.description: Real-Time Auctions & Bidding: Admin auction sessions, seller consignment, and reputation-based eligibility checks

targetUrl.description: Frontend destination. New auction notifications use the same route as auction banners and manual browsing. Legacy notifications may have no destination.

creatorRole.description: Immutable role group at creation; ADMIN precedes STAFF when priorities match
